tagline: A leading manufacturer and distributor of branded and private label products for the lawn & garden and pet supplies markets in the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Remarkable 34.9% increase despite a slight sales decline, demonstrating a significant structural improvement in operating profitability driven by productivity initiatives and cost reduction efforts.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved due to efficiency gains and lower raw material prices, despite tariffs.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement of 240 bps, indicating strong operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin increased due to gross margin improvement and reduced overhead expenses.
kpis.signal: Strong expansion of 220 bps, driven by cost reductions.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deductions and returns.
kpis.description: Sales declined by 2.2%, impacted by product line losses and unfavorable weather conditions.
kpis.signal: Slight sales decline, but profitability improved.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Operating income increased by 34.9% due to efficiency gains and lower expenses.
kpis.signal: Very strong growth despite lower sales.

kpis.name: Pet Segment Sales
